findings.finding: The sampling-kwarg relocation into extra_body is not specified to MERGE with any pre-existing extra_body, risking a silent overwrite of caller/pydantic-ai-supplied extra_body content.
findings.location: Plan section: Plan, 5th bullet ('The wrapper moves unsupported real sampling kwargs (temperature, top_p, top_k) into extra_body')
scenarios: pydantic-ai (or a future rebar path) passes its own extra_body to client.beta.messages.create; the wrapper overwrites it with {'temperature': ...}, silently dropping the caller's extra_body fields.
findings.suggested_fix: In the wrapper, do `extra_body = {**(kwargs.pop('extra_body', None) or {}), **relocated_sampling}` so pre-existing extra_body entries survive.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify a fail-CLOSED behavior for the ambiguous/absent-annotation case (e.g. raise LLMConfigError naming the unrecognized annotation, or probe by attempting httpx2 import) instead of silently defaulting to stdlib httpx, so an unrecognized 1.x contract fails loudly rather than reintroducing the `Invalid http_client` TypeError.
evidence: Plan: 'match annotation text containing httpx2.AsyncClient ... Default to stdlib httpx when the annotation is absent or ambiguous.'

1f35 root cause: constructing AsyncAnthropic(http_client=httpx.AsyncClient()) under anthropic 1.x raises the TypeError; string-matching an annotation is the only discriminator, so a 1.x SDK whose annotation does not string-match (e.g. a resolved type object rather than the forward-ref string, or a future annotation-format change) silently routes to the stdlib branch and re-breaks.

The detection is a heuristic over inspect.signature annotation TEXT; the failure mode of a wrong guess is not symmetric — guessing httpx2 wrongly on a 0.x SDK also breaks, so 'ambiguous' has no safe silent default.
findings.finding: The contract-detection default direction fails OPEN: when the http_client annotation is 'absent or ambiguous' the plan defaults to stdlib httpx, which under an actual 1.x/httpx2 SDK reintroduces the exact `TypeError: Invalid http_client ... Expected httpx2.AsyncClient` this ticket exists to fix.
findings.location: Plan section: Plan, 2nd bullet ('Detect the SDK contract ... Default to stdlib httpx when the annotation is absent or ambiguous')
scenarios: A future anthropic 1.x point release changes the annotation representation so the substring match misses; the seam silently builds a stdlib client and every Anthropic call TypeErrors at construction.
